_doc: A slat mat (#866; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/saloon/): the duckboard behind the bar that keeps the bartender's feet out of the slops, 6 ft long and 2 ft wide, 20 oak slats on two runners, old and worn (the slats baked: worn pine, slopped and trodden). The slats one member drawn as its slats (a duckboard breaks along a slat as one piece: fine for its few bodies), the runners two. The runners oak from the material library (old), never the floor's fir. The bar's run takes one every 6 ft. 3 physics bodies. ~9 kg. Written by tools/props/saloon.py.
